convention: AgentLinkOps package convention; not an industry schema

recipes.requiredInputs: Site, audience, supplied pages or context, requested outcome
recipes.expectedArtifact: Dated site brief with evidence limits and next task

availability.hostedOperations: require verified permission and available service access

optional: customer's browser or search tools
customer's first-party analytics
AgentLinkOps hosted reads with verified permission
customer's chosen record or file destination
search data with its date window and dimensions

contract.offlineOutput: Dated site brief from supplied material: site identity, reader need, relevant assets, cited facts, missing evidence and one proposed next task

limits.permissions: None for supplied-input preparation; hosted research needs a working connection, permission and service access
limits.cost: None for supplied-input preparation; any hosted command follows its own metering
limits.effects: No publishing, sending or record writes; output goes only to the destination the customer chose

references: source title, publisher, publication date, URL and retrieval date for each supported claim
contract.judgments: Suggestions without usable data are labelled hypotheses and kept apart from observed demand
checkpoints: brief saved and read back, or returned in conversation
recipe version, input references, completed artifact, uncertainties and next action
contract.recovery: Separate missing authentication, missing scope, unavailable feature, quota and temporary failure; continue from supplied context; compare a changed file before revising and keep customer edits

recipes.requiredInputs: Site brief, reader task, source material, output destination
recipes.expectedArtifact: Sourced draft with review receipts and publication state

availability.hostedOperations: require verified permission and available service access

optional: customer's browser for fetching sources
customer's site editing tools
AgentLinkOps hosted backlink research with access
optional content skills when the customer selects them

contract.offlineOutput: Sourced draft with review receipts and an explicit publication state
revisions: review receipts naming the reviewer or tool and the revision

limits.permissions: Site edits use the customer's own tools and authority
limits.cost: None from the recipe; optional hosted research follows its own metering
limits.effects: No publication; a release is separately authorized and verified after it happens

references: source title, publisher, publication date and URL for each factual claim
contract.judgments: Original calculations and assumptions are marked; no manufactured experience or results
checkpoints: draft revision, intended URL, source records, review receipts and unresolved findings
artifact read back from its chosen destination
contract.recovery: Missing sources leave claims unverified; a missing review tool leaves that pass incomplete; keep existing pages and customer edits on resume

recipes.requiredInputs: Product brief, asset state, candidate records, chosen CRM or sender, outreach constraints
recipes.expectedArtifact: Qualified candidates, reviewed draft, field mapping and readback or portable handoff

availability.hostedOperations: require verified permission and available service access

optional: browser, verifier or permitted hosted tool for fresh page checks
AgentLinkOps hosted supplier research with access
customer's CRM or sender, with its field schema read before any write
bundled local CRM when the customer chooses it
reply and suppression evidence

contract.offlineOutput: Eligible, rejected and unresolved candidates with reasons, a reviewed draft, and a portable handoff with logical labels when the destination schema is unavailable

limits.permissions: Destination writes need the destination's schema and the customer's write authorization
limits.cost: Research and drafting from supplied inputs require no AgentLinkOps provider charge. Selected fresh checks, supplier research and third-party agent or destination tools may incur their own costs.
limits.effects: Stops at the draft or handoff boundary: sends no messages and activates no sequence

references: command or method with its exact non-secret arguments
original idempotency or conditional request identifier
contract.judgments: Each eligible, rejected or unresolved decision carries its reason; draft claims need supplied facts and a dated observation
checkpoints: request saved before any remote write
operation receipt, parsed readback and local acknowledgement kept as separate facts
contract.recovery: Read the original operation by its saved identifier, then traverse the destination afresh from its first page; never replay with a new request identifier; an ambiguous write stays outcome unknown

recipes.requiredInputs: Exact source URL, destination and match scope, claim reference
recipes.expectedArtifact: Dated observation, reconciled claim and optional monitoring plan

availability.hostedOperations: require verified permission and available service access

optional: installed agentlinkops CLI for a local check
AgentLinkOps hosted check, history and monitoring tools with permission
customer's record system
prior observation
supplied CSV, JSON, JSONL or report for the review section

contract.offlineOutput: A review of supplied evidence with up to three actions, a dated observation with its reconciled claim, or an explicit unknown with its reason and next check

limits.permissions: Monitoring needs the customer's monitoring authorization; scopes belong to the selected operation
limits.cost: The review section makes no network calls, metered checks or recurring work; a local CLI check fetches the source page; hosted checks follow their command metering
limits.effects: No email, crawling, supplier acquisition, publishing, disavow submission or policy edits; repairs and watches stay proposals

contract.judgments: Recommendations are the reviewing agent's judgment with an evidence reference and limit; customer claims, supplier rows and product observations stay separately attributed
checkpoints: recipe version, record reference, scope, observation reference and next action
continuation block: recipe revision, input hashes, site binding, completed and unresolved work
contract.recovery: Read the original operation, then traverse the destination afresh; an unknown check makes no presence finding; never repeat a remote write to repair a local note

recipes.requiredInputs: Site, reader task, supplied pages or saved scan, chosen edit or handoff destination
recipes.expectedArtifact: Evidence-bound internal-link change plan with actual edit, publication and verification states kept separate

availability.hostedOperations: require verified permission and available service access

optional: customer site editor and release tools
connected AgentLinkOps internal-link scan/change tools
customer browser for authorized public readback
fresh source passage
existing change revisions and operation receipts

contract.offlineOutput: Reviewed source/target/anchor/passage plan with evidence, rejection reasons and unresolved coverage
revisions: source file hashes or scan ID and completion time

limits.permissions: Customer authority for records, site edits, release and fresh checks is separate; hosted calls require current access
limits.cost: Supplied-input review makes no network calls or metered checks; hosted verification and scans retain their own allowance, billing and cooldown rules
limits.effects: Selection starts no scan, schedule, site edit or publication; a published change state is a claim, not verification

contract.judgments: Attribute reader fit and anchor choice to the customer or agent; scores do not predict rankings; unknown access does not prove absence
checkpoints: reviewed plan and exact evidence binding
publication claim and independent verification recorded separately
contract.recovery: Read the original operation and saved revision after interruption; preserve customer edits and unknown outcomes; never repeat a mutation to repair a local note
